scripts.check: bunx tsc --noEmit && oxlint && oxfmt --check && bun run format:spec-cases:check
scripts.fix: bun run fix:typescript && bun run format:spec-cases
scripts.generate:hash-cases: bun run scripts/generate-hash-cases.ts && bun run format:spec-cases
scripts.format:spec-cases:check: cd .. && bun -e 'for (const path of ["spec/cases/parse/structural-depth.json", "spec-v2/cases/parse/structural-depth.json", "spec/cases/check/limits/structural-depth.json"]) JSON.parse(await Bun.file(path).text())' && ./typescript/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check 'spec/cases/**/*.json' 'spec-v2/cases/**/*.json' '!spec/cases/parse/structural-depth.json' '!spec-v2/cases/parse/structural-depth.json' '!spec/cases/check/limits/structural-depth.json'
